rootMetadata.dimensionsBasis: Original concept; not measured from user photos or certified capacity
rootMetadata.editing: Furniture and equipment are independently named editable object groups; props retain explicit supportedBy links.
rootMetadata.roofBehavior: Roof group includes complete ceiling plus front and right enclosing layers; archive retains this group visible.

limitations: Reports the actual exported static default scene; viewer interactions are checked separately in the browser.
Editable object names must be unique; shared nested asset mesh names are permitted.
Concept dimensions and static geometry checks do not establish measured building dimensions or any regulatory approval.
